criteria.detail: Every persisted payload and referenced file is checksummed.
AST check of direct agent-class calls.
Actual train/validation evidence audited before any training.
Exact supporting quotes resolve to checksummed snapshots; recommendations remain hypotheses.
Curated excerpts alone do not demonstrate web retrieval.
Test metrics are excluded from search and configuration selection.
Conventional baseline uses the same seed and selected splits; negative deltas are retained.
At least three completed seeds, with a shared validation-selected configuration.
Validation-calibrated abstention with a persistent benchmark review queue.
Every promoted stage has an independent reviewer report.
Decision source and stage are recorded; exact prompts/schema/results are retained.
Requires passing tests and measured fault injection for this exact source tree.
A transcript alone is not proof that retraining reproduces predictions and metrics.
Every unresolved reviewer issue requires an explicit approved mitigation.
Requires named independent demonstrator/reviewer, bound predictions and checksummed environment evidence.

unresolved_reviewer_issues: Class 5 (smooth muscle) / Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) confusion pair (80 samples each direction) is the dominant error source and will be over-represented in the abstained subset; model-quality observation carried forward.

Class 5 (smooth muscle) / Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) confusion pair (80 samples each direction; class-7 recall 0.525) is the dominant error source and will be over-represented in the 2486-sample abstained subset.
Class 5 (smooth muscle) precision is 0.608 and F1 0.710; 62/592 samples misclassified as class 1 (background) and 80 as class 7. The class-5/class-7 confusion pair is the dominant error source.
Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall is 0.525 and F1 0.651; 80/421 samples misclassified as class 5 (smooth muscle) and 62 as class 2 (debris).
